name: consistency-violation-interface-external-incomplete-reference
description: An interface stub whose `DEST` is not one a port may name. The stub is admissible on its own — a malformed reference pair loads, so a project carrying one stays readable — and what refuses is the model rule that holds the pair to the port interface `DEST` values both licensed schemas admit.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. The change set creates one interface stub whose `external_dest` is a component type's `DEST`.

authorization.notes: The scope covers the one address exactly, so the refusal is the model rule and not the authorization boundary.

input.intent: Carry the speed interface as a reference into the rest of the delivery.

value.name: IForeignSpeed
value.description: Declared by another file of the same delivery

expected.notes: One address, at the field the repair is about. The admitted set is the eight port interface `DEST` values both licensed schemas list — two of them, `PORT-INTERFACE` and `DATA-INTERFACE`, abstract, which is why the kind is never judged across a stub carrying one — compared as a set and never by suffix. A blank `external_ref` or one that is not an absolute path is the same rule, reported once on the stub and never again on the ports that name it; the rule does not ask whether the target exists, because the model cannot see another file of the delivery.
